title: Metathought is Turing non-computable and needs a quantum metalanguage

statements.text: Besides ordinary thought there is metathought, thinking about thought, which is Turing non-computable: it is formalized as a quantum metalanguage that controls the logic of the quantum mode and requires a quantum version of Tarski's Convention T, which bears on Penrose's conjecture from Gödel's theorem.

sources.quote: This is methatought, the process of thinking about ordinary thought
